source_items.title: iShares Ethereum Trust ETF — Prospectus (Form 424B3)
source_items.publisher: iShares Ethereum Trust ETF (SEC EDGAR, CIK 0002000638)

excerpts.text: the price of ether declined to below $1,600 in June 2026, representing a drawdown of more than 65%
the Ethereum network could be subject to changes that may adversely affect the value of ether.
digital asset validator operations have evolved from individual users to “professionalized” validating operations
Digital asset markets in the United States exist in a state of regulatory uncertainty
abandon the Ethereum blockchain for other blockchain or digital asset networks or protocols

challenges.question: BlackRock's ether fund prospectus says ether fell below 1,600 dollars in June 2026, a drawdown of more than 65 percent. What makes you confident the reasons behind that drop are gone?
The prospectus says changes to the Ethereum network could hurt ether's value. How does your thesis hold up if an upgrade goes wrong?
The prospectus notes validating has shifted from individuals to professional operations. Does that change how decentralized you think Ethereum really is?
The prospectus warns users could abandon Ethereum for other networks. Why would they stay?
The prospectus says U.S. digital asset markets are in a state of regulatory uncertainty. What happens to your thesis if ether is treated differently by regulators?
What is one specific thing that would prove your thesis wrong, and how would you notice it?
